dhaka_to_sajek-valley.overview: Travel overnight by luxury or non-AC coach to Khagrachari, then hire a 4x4 Chander Gari with Bangladesh Army security convoy up to the hill crest.

bus.notes: Night departure (10:00 PM - 11:30 PM) is strongly recommended to arrive in Khagrachari by 6:00 AM, in time for breakfast and the 10:00 AM Army Escort.

train.notes: Take train from Kamalapur to Feni Junction (3.5 hrs), then local CNG/Bus from Feni Mahipal to Khagrachari (2.5 hrs).

air.postFlightTransit: From Chattogram, hire a private microbus/AC taxi to Khagrachari (3.5 hrs, ৳4,500 - ৳6,000).

localTransit.estimatedFare: ৳8,000 - ৳10,500 (Entire Chander Gari 2-Day Return Reserve for 12-14 people); or CNG auto-rickshaw ৳4,000 - ৳5,000 (3-4 people)
localTransit.keyTips: Convoy times strictly enforced by Bangladesh Army at Baghaihat Checkpoint: Morning Escort 10:00 AM, Afternoon Escort 03:00 PM.

dhaka_to_coxs-bazar-sea-beach.overview: The iconic route connecting the capital to the world's longest natural unbroken sandy beach.

bus.notes: Premium luxury sleeper buses feature reclining pod beds, personal USB charging ports, and mineral water bottles.

availableTrains.name: Cox's Bazar Express (814)
availableTrains.route: Dhaka Kamalapur to Cox's Bazar Iconic Station

availableTrains.name: Paromita / Tourism Express (816)
availableTrains.route: Dhaka to Cox's Bazar Iconic Station

train.notes: Arrives at the oyster-shell shaped Cox's Bazar Iconic Railway Station. Book tickets 10 days in advance on eticket.railway.gov.bd.

air.distanceFromDestination: 3 km from Kolatoli beachfront hotel zone
air.postFlightTransit: Pre-paid battery auto-rickshaw (Tomtom) or AC cab takes only 10-15 minutes (৳150 - ৳400) to hotel.

localTransit.type: Tomtom (Electric Easybike), Open Jeep & Marine Drive 4x4
localTransit.estimatedFare: Tomtom per town trip: ৳20 - ৳50/seat. Full-day Marine Drive Jeep reserve to Inani & Himchari: ৳3,500 - ৳5,000.
localTransit.keyTips: Rent an open hood 4x4 Mahindra Jeep for an unforgettable sunset drive down the 80km Marine Drive.

dhaka_to_saint-martins-island.summary: Dhaka → Cox's Bazar / Teknaf → Bay Cruise Ship → Saint Martin's
dhaka_to_saint-martins-island.overview: Take an overnight bus or train to Cox's Bazar or Teknaf, then cruise across the azure waters of the Bay of Bengal.

bus.fareRange: ৳1,100 (Non-AC to Teknaf) - ৳2,500 (Direct AC Bus to Teknaf Damdamia Ghat)
bus.notes: Direct buses connect straight to the ship boarding jetty early morning.

train.notes: Arrive at Cox's Bazar station, then take connecting coastal shuttle or BIWTA cruise ship (when sailing from Cox's Bazar Nuniarchora ghat).

air.postFlightTransit: AC Microbus from Cox's Bazar Airport to Teknaf Damdamia ghat (2 hrs, ৳3,000 - ৳4,000 reserve) or direct ship from Cox's Bazar.

localTransit.type: Sea Cruise Ships (Keari Sindbad, Bay Cruiser, Karnafuly Express) & Island Van
localTransit.estimatedFare: Ship Roundtrip Ticket: ৳1,500 (Economy) - ৳3,200 (VIP AC Salon). Island manual cycle van: ৳100 - ৳300 per trip. Chera Dwip engine speed boat: ৳300 - ৳500/person return.
localTransit.keyTips: Ships depart Teknaf Ghat sharply between 09:00 AM - 09:30 AM and return from Saint Martin at 03:00 PM.

dhaka_to_sreemangal-tea-capital.overview: One of the most accessible and peaceful journeys in Bangladesh. The train ride through rural wetland marshes into rolling green tea slopes is iconic.

bus.notes: Buses run every 30 minutes throughout day and night from Sayedabad and Mohakhali.

train.notes: Parabat Express morning train offers spectacular views of misty paddy fields and tea orchards entering Moulvibazar.

air.postFlightTransit: Rent an AC taxi from Sylhet airport to Sreemangal (1.5 - 2 hours, ৳2,500 - ৳3,500).

localTransit.type: Rental Bicycle, CNG Auto-rickshaw, or Open Jeep
localTransit.estimatedFare: Bicycle rental: ৳150 - ৳250/day. CNG auto-rickshaw full-day reserve (Tea estates + Lawachara + Madhabpur Lake): ৳1,500 - ৳2,200.
localTransit.keyTips: Cycling through the tea gardens during morning fog is the most serene experience.

dhaka_to_sundarbans-mangrove.summary: Dhaka → Khulna / Mongla Port → Mangrove Cruiser Ship
dhaka_to_sundarbans-mangrove.overview: Thanks to the Padma Bridge, reaching Mongla Port from Dhaka now takes only 3.5 to 4.5 hours by highway, followed by luxury river cruisers sailing into the wild mangrove canals.

bus.notes: Direct buses cross the iconic Padma Bridge and go straight to Mongla river jetty.

train.type: Direct Railway via Padma Rail Link
train.notes: Arrives at Khulna Railway Station. From Khulna, take a 45-minute AC cab to Mongla Port.

air.postFlightTransit: AC Microbus/Taxi from Jashore Airport to Mongla Port (2 hrs, ৳3,000 - ৳4,000).

localTransit.type: Liveaboard Cruiser Vessel (3-Day All-Inclusive) & Wooden Dinghy Safari
localTransit.estimatedFare: 3-Day 2-Night Full Cruiser Tour (Cabin, Food, Forest Guide & Armed Guards): ৳12,000 - ৳22,000/person; Day trip engine trawler to Karamjal: ৳3,000 - ৳5,000 reserve.
localTransit.keyTips: Book with registered Sundarbans tour operators (e.g., The Guide Tours, Silver Wave, Bengal Tours) well in advance.

dhaka_to_bandarban-nilgiri.summary: Dhaka → Bandarban Town → Chander Gari to Nilgiri / Ruma
dhaka_to_bandarban-nilgiri.overview: Traverse from central plains to towering heights through scenic hill passes.

bus.notes: Night coaches (10:30 PM - 11:30 PM) arrive in Bandarban at dawn (06:30 AM).

train.notes: From Chattogram Railway Station, take an AC Purabi / Purbani bus or private taxi to Bandarban (2 hrs, ৳180 bus / ৳2,200 taxi).

air.postFlightTransit: AC Microbus from Chattogram Airport directly to Bandarban town (2.5 hrs, ৳3,500 - ৳4,500).

localTransit.type: 4x4 Chander Gari (Mahindra / Toyota Land Cruiser) & Hill CNG
localTransit.estimatedFare: Nilgiri reserve roundtrip (same day): ৳5,500 - ৳7,000; Ruma Bazar reserve: ৳4,500 - ৳5,500; Local hill CNG to Golden Temple: ৳300 - ৳500.
localTransit.keyTips: Carry 5-6 photocopies of National ID (NID) or Passport for verification at military checkpoints along the hill roads.

dhaka_to_tanguar-haor.summary: Dhaka → Sunamganj → Tahirpur Ghat → Luxury Houseboat
dhaka_to_tanguar-haor.overview: Journey to the foothills of Meghalaya, board a wooden luxury houseboat, and live on the water.

bus.notes: Night bus around 10:30 PM arrives in Sunamganj at 5:30 AM.

train.notes: From Sylhet Railway Station, take an AC microbus or local bus to Sunamganj (1.5 hrs, ৳150 bus / ৳2,000 car).

air.postFlightTransit: AC Microbus from Sylhet Airport directly to Tahirpur Boat Ghat (2.5 hrs, ৳4,000 - ৳5,000).

localTransit.type: CNG / Bike to Tahirpur Ghat + Luxury Overnight Houseboat
localTransit.estimatedFare: Sunamganj town to Tahirpur Ghat (CNG): ৳120/seat or ৳600 reserve. Houseboat 2-Day Package with 5 gourmet meals & haor tour: ৳7,500 - ৳15,000/person (or full boat reserve ৳40,000 - ৳1,20,000).
localTransit.keyTips: Houseboats book out 3-4 weeks ahead during peak monsoon (July-September). Early booking is essential.

dhaka_to_kuakata-daughter-of-ocean.summary: Dhaka → Barishal / Patuakhali → Kuakata (Via Padma Bridge or Luxury River Launch)
dhaka_to_kuakata-daughter-of-ocean.typicalDuration: 5.5 - 6 Hours (Direct AC Bus) or Overnight Launch
dhaka_to_kuakata-daughter-of-ocean.overview: Cross the mighty Padma & Payra river bridges by smooth highway, or relish a classic overnight triple-decker river launch down the southern delta.

bus.notes: Padma Bridge and Payra 4-lane bridges have reduced travel time from 14 hours down to under 6 hours!

train.notes: Cruising on a giant illuminated river launch across the Meghna river with fresh Hilsha fish dinner is a quintessentially Bengali experience.

air.postFlightTransit: AC Microbus/Taxi from Barishal Airport to Kuakata Beach (2.5 hrs, ৳3,500 - ৳4,500).

localTransit.estimatedFare: Guided beach motorbike tour (Red Crab Beach, Gangamati, Buddhist Well, Rakhine Village): ৳800 - ৳1,200 return.
localTransit.keyTips: Wake up at 05:00 AM to catch the sunrise over the eastern beach, then relax on the western beach for sunset.

dhaka_to_birishiri-ceramic-hills.overview: Cross the old Brahmaputra river plains to the white clay mineral hills of Netrokona near the Meghalaya border.

bus.notes: Direct buses depart Mohakhali starting from 06:00 AM.

train.notes: Get down at Netrokona or Shyamganj Junction, then 1-hr local CNG to Durgapur.

air.nearestAirport: No direct commercial airport nearby; road transit from Dhaka is recommended.
air.postFlightTransit: Recommended mode is direct road transit via Mohakhali.

localTransit.type: Local Motorbike Rental & Wooden Shomeshwari Boat
localTransit.estimatedFare: Local motorbike pilot for full-day tour (Ceramic Lake, Ranikhong, Garo Academy, Border viewpoint): ৳800 - ৳1,200. Shomeshwari river wooden boat crossing: ৳10 - ৳20/person.
localTransit.keyTips: Hiring a local motorbike rider as your guide is the most flexible way to navigate the gravel riverside roads.

dhaka_to_sompur-mahavihara.overview: Comfortable broad-gauge rail transit through the green northern agricultural belt to the ancient 8th-century Buddhist monastic citadel.

bus.notes: Crosses the Bangabandhu Jamuna Bridge across the Brahmaputra river.

train.notes: Nilsagor and Ekota Express arrive during pleasant daylight hours. De-board at Joypurhat Station.

air.postFlightTransit: AC Taxi from Rajshahi Airport to Paharpur (2 hrs, ৳3,000 - ৳4,000).

localTransit.estimatedFare: Joypurhat Station to Paharpur Sompur Mahavihara gate: CNG ৳200 - ৳300 reserve, or shared auto ৳40/seat (approx 20-25 mins).
localTransit.keyTips: Pair with a visit to the nearby 16th-century black basalt Kushumba Mosque in Manda.
